text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Summer training camp starts today! Under 
the blazing sun, I'm doing special 
training with Ines Fujin!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
"—Well then, Ryan. I will be in your care 
for this afternoon's training session."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! Let's get pumped up and build up our 
stamina for the Tenno Sho (Autumn)!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Since I won't be able to run this time, as 
a Mejiro... I'm entrusting it all to you.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Huh!? Umm, I was just wondering if I need 
to build muscle first to become like 
Ryan-chan~.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
"What are you staring at, Trainer?! Hurry 
up and put your bags in your room."

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Summer camp is pretty short, you know? We 
gotta make sure we don't waste any time!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And so, summer training camp began!
